lines.t: We ain't no church built by the hands of men
Who holds the truth, it's not within
For the temple that he claims is his
Is the heart of the faithful who live
We are the body, we are the light
Following his voice through the night
No walls can hold what's born anew
Only spirit, only truth
Every soul who hears his call
Every heart that surrenders all
In him the power and love will dwell
The living stones that break the shell
We are the body, we are the light
Following his voice through the night
No walls can hold what's born anew
Only spirit, only truth
Not in steeples, not in stone
But in mercy we are known
With the spirit burning deep inside
We walk with him, we will not hide
We are the body, we are the life
Following his voice
Through the night
No walls can hold what's born anew
Only spirit, only truth
Thank you.
